changes: Adds UNGEMACH, a dissonant, living drone machine for dark techno: sixteen detuned voices, a sub and noise in stereo.
DISS widens the chord from unison to a scream while its pitch rises; WAVE has 32 waveforms from dull to shrill.
RATE drifts pitch, filter and level freely or pulses in time with the track; PNCH punches on every trig.
Known issue: tested only on the author's MKI; a busy pattern can skip a few of its frames a second.
